slides.0.title: Germany's Other White Grape Varieties

slides.1.title: 🍇 Germany's Important White Varieties
slides.1.items.0.text: Müller-Thurgau: Germany's second most planted variety; fresh and easy-drinking, common in Rheinhessen
slides.1.items.1.text: Silvaner: the soul of Franken; bottled in the Bocksbeutel; dry and mineral
slides.1.items.2.text: Grauburgunder (Pinot Gris): especially common in Baden; rich and silky, with apricot and honey notes
slides.1.items.3.text: Weißburgunder (Pinot Blanc): fresh and elegant with vibrant acidity; also used for Sekt
slides.1.items.4.text: Gewürztraminer: spice, lychee and rose; ripely sweet, common in Pfalz
slides.1.items.5.text: Scheurebe: a Riesling cross with intense blackcurrant and grapefruit
slides.3.title: Quick Quiz
slides.3.questions.0.question: Which is the most famous region for Silvaner?
slides.3.questions.0.explanation: Franken is the spiritual home of Silvaner, where the variety reaches its finest expression — bottled in the distinctive flat Bocksbeutel, with a dry, full body and signature minerality.
